map.注塑成型周期计算 使用指南: Injection Molding Cycle Calculator User Guide
map.注塑成型周期计算器求注射、保压、冷却与开合模的总周期时间，辅助产能节拍与模具方案: The injection molding cycle calculator gives the total cycle time for injection, holding, cooling and mold opening and closing, helping optimize production takt and mold plans; suited to plastics processing scheduling.
map.注塑成型周期 = 注射 + 保压 + 冷却 + 开模 + 顶出 + 关模: Injection molding cycle = injection + holding + cooling + mold opening + ejection + mold closing
map.注塑工艺/排产时，把注射+保压+冷却+开模+顶出+关模六段时间相加得到成型总周期: For injection molding process planning and scheduling, add the six stages of injection, holding, cooling, mold opening, ejection and mold closing to get the total molding cycle, then compute shots per hour, daily output and the number of good parts.
map.瓶颈定位时，用周期条形图比较各阶段占比，通常冷却时间占周期大半，是缩短周期的首要: When locating the bottleneck, use a cycle bar chart to compare the share of each stage; cooling usually takes most of the cycle and is the first target when shortening the cycle.
map.多腔模具核算时，用单件耗时=总周期÷腔数 评估产能，腔数越多单件越快，但需更大锁: When costing a multi-cavity mold, assess capacity with unit time = total cycle / cavities; more cavities make each unit faster, but require greater clamping force and more uniform runners.
map.：六段时间 2/5/15/2/1/2 秒 → 总周期 27 s；每小时注射 36: : Six stages of 2/5/15/2/1/2 s give a total cycle of 27 s; shots per hour 3600/27, about 133.3; with a 4-cavity mold, 20 h of daily operation and 95% yield, daily output is 133.3x20x4, about 10667 pieces, of which about 10133 are good; unit time is 27/4 = 6.75 s. If cooling is cut from 15 s to 10 s, the cycle shortens to 22 s and daily output rises by about 23%.
map.冷却时间为什么往往是瓶颈？: Why is cooling time often the bottleneck?
map.熔体在模内固化占周期大半，冷却不足则顶出变形、需延长。可优化模具水路、降低水温或: Solidification of the melt inside the mold takes up most of the cycle; insufficient cooling causes deformation on ejection and needs a longer time. Optimize the mold water channels, lower the water temperature or improve heat conduction to shorten it; but over-pursuing a short cycle sacrifices appearance and dimensional stability.
map.多腔模具怎么算单件成本？: How is the unit cost calculated for a multi-cavity mold?
map.单件耗时 = 总周期÷腔数，腔数翻倍则单件时间减半；但多腔需更大锁模力、更均匀的: Unit time = total cycle / number of cavities, so doubling the cavities halves the unit time; but more cavities need greater clamping force, more uniform runner balance and higher tooling cost, so weigh this against yield and machine capability.
